subject: Renewal: Helix Labs — hybrid multi-year + usage-trigger
messages:
From: Amandeep Singh <a.singh@helixlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: ask on multi-year + usage triggers

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks for the conversation last week. Leadership at Helix wants to lock in predictable economics but preserve flexibility if our inference usage spikes during model launches. Two asks from procurement and engineering:

- Multi-year pricing (2–3 years) with an opt-in auto-rollover for year 2/3.
- Usage-triggered top-ups: if monthly tokens exceed 120% of committed, an automated top-up should kick in rather than immediate overage bills — we prefer a structured top-up with a capped rate.
- Burst capacity: we need a 24–48 hour burst window that won't immediately trigger full overage rates (safety band).

I've attached our forecast (helix_usage_forecast_q3-q4.xlsx). Can Redwood draft a structure that gives us cost predictability but operational safety for launches? Also include a suggested procurement timeline — legal wants a final term sheet by 7/10.

Thanks,
Amandeep
Amandeep Singh
Head of ML Ops, Helix Labs
Procurement: procure@helixlabs.com

Attachment: helix_usage_forecast_q3-q4.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amandeep Singh <a.singh@helixlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: ask on multi-year + usage triggers

Amandeep —

Appreciate the clarity and the forecast. Attached is a first-pass "hybrid term" proposal (redwood_hybrid_term_proposal_v1.pdf) that we think maps well to Helix's needs. High-level summary below:

- Structure: 2-year base term with an optional third year auto-rollover. Year 1 is a committed token band (X tokens/month) with Year 2 adjustable by +/- 20% based on trailing 6-month usage. Auto-rollover requires explicit opt-in at 30 days before renewal.

- Usage-trigger top-ups:
  * Trigger threshold: monthly usage > 120% of committed average for two consecutive months.
  * Top-up mechanism: immediate provisional top-up allocation equal to the exceed amount at a discounted top-up rate (10% below standard overage) which converts to committed volume if sustained for the following 3 months.
  * Safety cap: Helix sets a hard monthly cap that prevents charges beyond an agreed ceiling unless explicitly approved.

- Burst window: 48-hour burst buffer applied to platform events (model launch tags). During the buffer we apply a reduced overage multiplier (0.6x of overage rate) to avoid penalizing short spikes.

- Escrowed credits: as a gesture to support your Q4 launch plan we propose an escrowed credit pool equal to 5% of Year 1 committed spend to offset initial top-ups. Credits vest over the first 90 days.

- Procurement / billing: We can support 30/45 day terms; prefer 30 for the first year. Legal redlines we've seen relate to auto-renew notice and data retention clauses — Karthik, can your team include the KMS/retention bullet for SOC2 audit response (copy below)?

If this looks directionally right I can get Marissa to add pricing tiers and a signed DDQ addendum. We can aim to get to a final term sheet by 2026-07-09 to meet your legal deadline of 7/10.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_hybrid_term_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amandeep Singh <a.singh@helixlabs.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procure@helixlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: ask on multi-year + usage triggers

Amandeep / team —

Thanks — adding pricing context so you can run numbers against the forecast. Key points:

- Year 1 committed band (example): 120M tokens/month at $0.0012/token. Overages billed monthly with the trigger-topup discount applied per Evelyn's note.
- Year 2 mechanism: true-up +/- 20% based on trailing 6-month average; step pricing if Year 2 committed band > Year 1 by >50%.
- Escrow credits shown as a contra line item in the first invoice (credit code: HLX-ESCROW-5).

I'm attaching a short pricing CSV (pricing_summary_v2.csv) with three scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive). A couple of procurement items to confirm: billing contact, desired invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly), and whether you need PO numbers on invoices.

Legal note (visibility): our standard auto-rollover clause includes a 30-day notice to opt-out; if you need extended notice we can discuss but that changes the renewal mechanics.

On SOC2 / KMS: Karthik — can you confirm we can provide an architecture diagram + KMS key management whitepaper for Helix's auditor? If so I will include it in the DDQ.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_summary_v2.csv (CSV, 4 KB)
